author: davidarngar
text: Claude Code exposed users' email addresses to third-party websites without their knowledge. When visiting certain sites, the agent could include a user's personal email address in the HTTP User-Agent header, potentially triggering dozens of scam emails per day.

author: Itsfoss
text: Use Claude code for development? Your email address is leaked to every website Claude fetches on your behalf. The AI that is finding bugs in all the legacy software is not able to create a bug-free software for itself?

author: hackerlogs
text: Claude Code was stuffing your account email into outbound User-Agent headers on web and shell tool calls. Developers reported scam floods after third parties harvested it. Anthropic says it was not an intentional feature.

author: Abbas_Mistrah
text: Your agent harness leaked its own keys. OpenHuman <0.57.5 wrote the RPC bearer into SQLite, logs and RPC responses (CVE-2026-54145, 8.8). Patch, then rotate.

author: battista212
text: OpenAI cites 81 novel Firefox vulnerabilities found, exploits for 948 Linux kernel flaws, and a critical Brotli RCE bug caught during development — released first to its Daybreak Red red-teaming program.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: AI found the PHP bugs. Now it's finding them everywhere. Chrome 157 shipped this week with 213 fixes — 14 of them credited to Anthropic researchers assisted by AI.

author: MarwanMoftah
text: XSA-523 (CVE-2026-102703/102704): Xen grant-copy bugs let a guest read/write other guests and Dom0. Who: Xen 4.6+, XCP-ng, Qubes. Fix: upstream 4.17+ patches (Nov 3); reboot Dom0. Discovered by Anthropic.

author: amartya_jha_
text: Claude wasn't alone on the CVE credit. Xen also credited our team at @CodeAntAI for independently finding this 11-year-old bug and building a working guest-to-dom0 exploit. Blog: Xenbleed grant-copy cache bug (CVE-2026-102704).

author: Abbas_Mistrah
text: Your MCP debugger is attack surface. Pillar found RCE in MCP Inspector: on Windows/WSL a remote server's OAuth URL hit PowerShell during login (CVE-2026-119025, 8.8). Upgrade to 2.12.0+.

author: 2Workly
text: Attackers exploit LiteLLM flaw CVE-2026-40217 to escalate API keys and resell enterprise access via Jet Night. Mandiant reports losses over $1M. Audit model gateways and enforce rate limits.

author: ThreatIntelDgst
text: UPDATE: Mandiant says attackers exploited LiteLLM CVE-2026-40217 in one LLMjacking intrusion to upgrade ordinary keys to admin credentials, adding a new route from stolen cloud access to control of AI accounts.

author: RuntimeAI_io
text: The LiteLLM supply chain hit is the one that should keep everyone up at night — a compromised package in a widely-used AI proxy layer means credential theft at scale across the entire LLM toolchain.

author: _pksharma
text: Threat actors weaponize agentic AI (ARTEX) to advance from GitHub secret discovery to Azure Key Vault data exfiltration in five minutes. Microsoft Threat Intelligence and Todyl documented the intrusions.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: hunters of an AI pentest tool got a root shell, BadByte says. tomicdd/artex: ~7,946 pulls by Nov 3. Backdoor only in the image; GitHub source looked clean. 62 public consoles served it Nov 2–4. Docker removed images Nov 5.

author: AgentFilipHQ
text: Hundreds of servers running Artex, an AI penetration testing tool, are exposed to the open internet, per TechCrunch. Anyone who finds one can use the hacking tool. This is a deployment failure, repeated hundreds of times.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: Hijacked enterprise LLM access is running up cloud AI bills of more than $100,000 a day. Google reports LLMJacking incidents in 2026 in which attackers used compromised credentials to run large generative AI jobs on enterprise Google Cloud LLM accounts.

author: Sujeet
text: Check Point found AI agent instruction hijacking: prompt adware that injects ads through a jailbroken agent. Prompt injection isn't a lab curiosity anymore.

author: ZetsubosenseiG
text: Postman desktop update silently installed plugins into Claude Code and Codex. In Codex, it added a SessionStart hook instructing the agent — a security risk in AI agent development.

author: SeanJHKwon
text: Someone scanned the 99 most-starred MCP servers on GitHub (9,965 tools total) for security bugs. Hidden prompt-injection in descriptions: 0. The real vulnerabilities were much worse, and half the HTTP servers had the same bug.

author: Pick_Analytica
text: The Hacker News: SSHole is already being exploited. Previdian got root on an Alpine OpenSSH honeypot less than 9 hours after the CVE. Eight attempts came from one Japan IP. Update to OpenSSH 10.6p2 and restart sshd if you run musl without PAM.

author: Huntio
text: CVE-2026-123158: OpenSSH Authentication Bypass Already Under Attack. SSHole affects musl-based Linux systems without PAM, including Alpine Linux on default settings.

author: CCBalert
text: Warning: Actively exploited CVE-2026-123158 (CVSS 8.1) affects OpenSSH sshd on Linux systems using musl libc without PAM, allowing remote attackers to bypass password authentication.

author: jeromerousselot
text: sshole critical ssh vulnerability on Alpine Linux, OpenWRT Linux and all other Linux systems using musl library instead of glibc. Anyone can get a remote ssh user shell by entering a random password longer than 256 characters. https://sshhole.com/

author: InvisDeveloper
text: CVE-2026-58115 is a CVSS 10 in Node-RED, and it's idiotically simple: the admin API has no authentication. One POST request deploys a flow that runs shell commands with max privileges. Already exploited!!

author: 0xmrma_
text: Clone2Creds / CVE-2026-62960. A zero-day I discovered in Git for Windows. Clone a repository. I have your credentials. Full technical writeup and exploit on GitHub.

author: tihana_dam
text: WP: update to 7.1.4, but block /wp-content/upgrade/ first. CVE-2026-119977 is actively exploited, the flaw sits in the updater itself. Deny web access to folder, confirm 403, then update.

author: zerohuntai
text: Exploited this week, and the build that fixes it: WordPress (CVE-2026-119977): 7.1.4 / 7.0.8 / 6.9.11 / 6.8.12; OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158): 10.6p2; Ivanti Connect Secure (CVE-2026-111357): latest build for your branch.

author: emits_ca
text: Zyxel GS1900 owners: June's Patch 2 firmware did NOT stop this zero-day. CVE-2026-107441 (8.8) lets a network attacker run commands with no login. Install your model's 2.90 Patch 3 build.

author: OrigoHubTech
text: Zyxel patches the CVE-2026-107441 zero-day in GS1900 switches, exploited against nearly 1,000 devices. Binarly says the June fix didn't stop it. Install Patch 3 for your model.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical Pre-Auth RCE in Apache OFBiz (CVE-2026-83542, CVSS 9.8). Multipart upload stages widget XML & overrides mainDecoratorLocation to run unsandboxed Groovy code without auth. Action: Upgrade to 24.09.08.

author: CCBalert
text: Warning: Critical CVE-2026-122006 (CVSS 9.8) affects Ruby on Rails Active Storage, allowing unauthenticated attackers to read and write server files via malicious image uploads processed by ImageMagick.

author: thiscitze
text: CVE-2026-118423 - WP Libre Form <= 1.5.0.1. Unauthenticated upload: a .php file lands in wp-content/uploads and executes. RCE. CVSS 10.0. PoC available.

author: cvedotnow
text: Newly rated critical, disclosed Nov 2. Apache Syncope: 4 critical CVEs. Worst: remote code execution via JUEL expressions in workflows (CVE-2026-109083). No patch listed yet.

author: CloudDoctrineHQ
text: Cisco confirms two critical PHP RCE flaws (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619), tracked as PHP2shell, affect Expressway, URWB and Duo Access Gateway. Patches available.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-83844: Microsoft Paint RCE Fix Now Available — Why Windows Update Won't Deliver It. Store build required.

author: UK_Daniel_Card
text: FYI I think the MS PAINT 'RCE' is not an RCE! I think there was a mess up on the CVSS and it should be CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H = 7.0 (High).

author: vulnipulse
text: NetApp: 21 new CVEs. Most severe: CVE-2026-100075 (CRITICAL) - Linux Kernel Vulnerability in NetApp Products.

author: Levitt_Matt
text: Chainalysis Breach Exposes All Users' Credentials, Forces Shutdown of Key Services

author: dailytechonx
text: Urgent: Chainalysis just disclosed a breach that exposed all users' credentials—including password hashes and live tokens. Reactor, Data Solutions, KYT, and Address Screening are offline.

author: king_steph10051
text: GitBook disclosed on November 5 that attackers breached its production environment via an SSO vulnerability, forging employee sessions and pulling internal Cloudflare keys before the incident was contained.
